desc: Sort arrays A, B, C in descending order.
Implement a max-heap (using negative values for Python's min-heap) to store tuples `(-value, i, j, k)`.
Initialize the heap with the triple `(0, 0, 0)` and its value.
Pop the largest element from the heap $K$ times. On each pop, generate new neighbors according to the rule: push `(i+1, j, k)`; if `i==0` push `(i, j+1, k)`; if `i==0` and `j==0` push `(i, j, k+1)`.
The value of the $K$-th popped element is the answer. Print it.
